# Snake Game using Python and pygame
import pygame
import random

# Initialize pygame
pygame.init()

# Set up screen dimensions
screen_width = 600
screen_height = 400
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((screen_width, screen_height))
pygame.display.set_caption("Snake Game")

# Set up clock for game loop
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Set up snake attributes
snake_speed = 15
score = 0
food_pos = (0, 0)

# Colors
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
GREEN = (0, 255, 0)
RED = (255, 0, 0)
YELLOW = (255, 255, 0)

# Set up snake
snake = [(100, 100), (120, 100), (140, 100)]
snake_direction = "right"

# Game loop
running = True
while running:
    clock.tick(10)

    # Check for events
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

    # Move snake
    if snake_direction == "right":
        new_head = (snake[-1][0] + 10, snake[-1][1])
        if new_head not in snake:
            snake.append(new_head)
        else:
            snake.pop(0)
            snake.append(new_head)
    elif snake_direction == "left":
        new_head = (snake[-1][0] - 10, snake[-1][1])
        if new_head not in snake:
            snake.append(new_head)
        else:
            snake.pop(0)
            snake.append(new_head)
    elif snake_direction == "up":
        new_head = (snake[-1][0], snake[-1][1] - 10)
        if new_head not in snake:
            snake.append(new_head)
        else:
            snake.pop(0)
            snake.append(new_head)
    elif snake_direction == "down":
        new_head = (snake[-1][0], snake[-1][1] + 10)
        if new_head not in snake:
            snake.append(new_head)
        else:
            snake.pop(0)
            snake.append(new_head)

    # Check for food collision
    if new_head == food_pos:
        score += 10
        food_pos = (random.randint(0, 300), random.randint(0, 300))
        if score >= 100:
            running = False

    # Draw snake
    screen.fill(BLACK)
    for pos in snake:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (pos[0], pos[1], 10, 10))

    # Draw food
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, YELLOW, (food_pos[0], food_pos[1], 10, 10))

    # Draw score
    pygame.font.SysFont(None, 20).render_string(f"Score: {score}", WHITE, True)
    pygame.display.flip()

pygame.quit()
